questions.question: In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. Statements: All phones are TVs. Some TVs are cars. Some big are cars. Conclusions: I. Some TVs are phones. II. Some big are TVs. III. All big are cars.

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’; ‘A − B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’; ‘A × B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’ and ‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’. Based on the above, how is 4 related to 1 if ‘4 × 3 − 2 − 1’?
questions.questionHtml:
In a certain code language,
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’;
‘A − B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’;
‘A × B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’ and
‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.
Based on the above, how is 4 related to 1 if ‘4 × 3 − 2 − 1’?
questions.solution:
4 is the wife of 3, 3 is the brother of 2 and 2 is the brother of 1.

​

So, 4 is the 'Brother's wife' of 1.

questions.question: What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and '×' are interchanged and '−' and '÷' are interchanged? 95 − 19 × 4 + 6 ÷ 16 = ?
questions.questionHtml:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and '×' are interchanged and '−' and '÷' are interchanged?
95 − 19 × 4 + 6 ÷ 16 = ?
questions.solution:
Given equation: 95 − 19 × 4 + 6 ÷ 16 = ?

After interchanging the signs then:

⇒ 95 ÷ 19 + 4 × 6 - 16 = ? ⇒ ? = 5 + 4 × 6 - 16 ⇒ ? = 5 + 24 - 16 ⇒ ? = 29 - 16 = 13

questions.question: 80 is related to 99 following certain logic. Following the same logic, 0 is related to 3. To which of the following numbers is 35 related, following the same logic? (NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.questionHtml: 80 is related to 99 following certain logic. Following the same logic, 0 is related to 3. To which of the following numbers is 35 related, following the same logic? (NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

Logic: n2 - 1.

Now,

80 is related to 99

→ 92 - 1 = 81 - 1 = 80,

→ 102 - 1 = 100 - 1 = 99,

0 is related to 3

→ 12 - 1 = 1 - 1 = 0,

→ 22 - 1 = 4 - 1 = 3,

Similarly, for 35 and 49

→ 62 - 1 = 36 - 1 = 35,

→ 72 - 1 = 49 - 1 = 48.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

Additional InformationTheir is a logic followed here,  logic is n^2-1 and next is (n+1)^2 -1 

Like:- 35 is 6^2 -1 then for next number (n+1)^2 -1

questions.question: Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. Statements: Some cups are glasses. No glass is a stone. All stones are metals. Conclusions: I. All cups can never be stones. II. No cup is a metal. III. All metals can never be glasses.
questions.questionHtml:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if
they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the
statements.
Statements:
Some cups are glasses.
No glass is a stone.
All stones are metals.
Conclusions:
I. All cups can never be stones.
II. No cup is a metal.
III. All metals can never be glasses.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

Conclusions:

I. All cups can never be stones. - True (because Some cups are glasses and No glass is a stone. As there is no direct relation between cups and stones. So, All cups can never be stones it is true)

II. No cup is a metal. - False (because there is no direct relation between cups and metal. So, it can be possible but not definite)

III. All metals can never be glasses. - True (because All stones are metals and No glass is a stone. So, All metals can never be glasses it is true)
